details: Found while adding the D878UVII. Channel 129 was read/written at 0x00802000 (channel-extension area) instead of 0x00840000. Reads of channels 129+ wrong; a write could overwrite extension records. Desktop and Web Programmer fixed. No hardware reports affected.
summary: Channels 129+ used a 1000-per-bank layout; QDMR/CPS layout is 128 per bank
